items.prompt:
What do you use a keyboard for?

A) To draw pictures
B) To type letters and words
items.answer: B) To type letters and words

steps: A keyboard has keys for letters, numbers, and symbols. You press the keys to type words on a screen.

items.prompt:
Which key do you press to remove a letter you typed by mistake?

A) Enter
B) Backspace

steps: The backspace key deletes the last letter or character you typed.

items.prompt:
What is a digital tool?

A) A pencil or crayon
B) A computer, tablet, or other electronic device
items.answer: B) A computer, tablet, or other electronic device

steps: Digital tools use electricity and screens. Pencils and crayons are non-digital writing tools.

items.prompt:
How does typing on a computer help you fix mistakes?

A) You can press backspace to delete the mistake and type again.
B) You have to use white-out to cover the mistake.
items.answer: A) You can press backspace to delete the mistake and type again.

steps: On a computer, mistakes can be deleted with the backspace key without any mess. White-out is only for paper.

items.prompt:
Which tool could you use to type a story?

A) A hammer
B) A tablet with a keyboard
items.answer: B) A tablet with a keyboard

steps: A tablet with a keyboard is a digital writing tool. A hammer is not a writing tool.

items.prompt:
What happens when you press a letter key on a keyboard?

A) The letter appears on the screen.
B) The screen turns off.
items.answer: A) The letter appears on the screen.

steps: When you press a letter key, that letter shows up on the screen where the cursor is located.

items.prompt:
Which is an example of sharing writing digitally?

A) Giving a printed paper to a classmate
B) Sending a typed story by email
items.answer: B) Sending a typed story by email

steps: Sharing digitally means using a device to send or post writing. Email is a digital sharing tool.

items.prompt:
Can you type on a keyboard without electricity?

A) No, computers and tablets need electricity or battery power to work.
B) Yes, keyboards work without electricity.
items.answer: A) No, computers and tablets need electricity or battery power to work.

steps: Digital tools require electricity or a charged battery. Without power, the device will not turn on.

items.prompt:
What is the SPACE BAR used for on a keyboard?

A) To make a space between words
B) To make letters bigger
items.answer: A) To make a space between words

steps: The space bar is the long key at the bottom of the keyboard. You press it to put a space between words.

items.prompt:
Which is an advantage of typing a story instead of writing it by hand?

A) You never need to think about what to write.
B) You can easily change or fix words without messy erasing.
items.answer: B) You can easily change or fix words without messy erasing.

steps: Typing allows you to delete and retype words cleanly. Handwriting requires erasing, which can leave smudges.

items.prompt:
A student types her story on a computer. Her teacher wants to read it without printing it. How can the student share it?

A) Read it aloud from the screen
B) Email it to the teacher
items.answer: B) Email it to the teacher

steps: Emailing the file allows the teacher to open and read it on their own device without printing.

items.prompt:
What is the ENTER key used for?

A) To start a new line or paragraph
B) To delete all your work
items.answer: A) To start a new line or paragraph

steps: The Enter key moves the cursor to the next line. It is used to start a new paragraph or create space between lines.

items.prompt:
Which of these is a digital way to read a story?

A) Reading a library book
B) Reading a story on a tablet
items.answer: B) Reading a story on a tablet

steps: A tablet is a digital device. Reading on a tablet is a digital reading experience. A library book is a print resource.

items.prompt:
What does 'publish' mean in writing?

A) To share your finished writing with readers
B) To start writing for the first time
items.answer: A) To share your finished writing with readers

steps: Publishing means making your final writing available for others to read. It comes after writing, revising, and editing.

items.prompt:
Which is better for writing when there is no computer nearby?

A) Writing by hand on paper
B) Waiting for a computer
items.answer: A) Writing by hand on paper

steps: Paper and pencil do not need electricity. Writing by hand is the best option when no digital tools are available.
